top_reviews.title: Love them

top_reviews.title: Beautiful!
top_reviews.text: So the brown color is definitely beautiful!  They do run large, as most cowgirl boots do so buy at least a half size smaller than your usual shoe size.  The leather is soft and needs to air out as it comes with a factory chemical or dye smell.  My only complaint is the plastic heel is a bit cheap looking.  The square toe makes my feet look smaller and they look great with boot cut jeans!  The bottoms are hard, not rubberized.  The stitching is well done and seems like it will hold up nicely.

top_reviews.title: So Cute and Eye-Catching Plus Roomy Inside
top_reviews.text: These cowboy boots are so cute and eye-catching!  I love the contrast between the black boots and the yellow sunflower embroidery.  Like any fashion boots, the inside soles are flat.  I love that the interior is roomy enough that I can fit orthopedic inserts inside for cushioning that makes these boots more comfortable to wear.  These boots have a roomy toe box inside which I also like.  My rating is 5 stars for these boots for the stylist sunflowers plus the straps that fit at the ankle level.
